content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stock photos

PayPal and Stripe claim to empower creators by providing easy-to-use platforms for selling digital products. However, their geographical restrictions limit access to only 46 countries out of 195 on earth, leaving many creators without options. COREMERCH, on the other hand, offers a comprehensive sovereign commerce stack that enables creators across the globe to retain their autonomy. With tools like NOWPayments, creators can accept crypto payments without geopolitical restrictions, ensuring that they can conduct business freely regardless of their location.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

PayPal is notorious for its account suspension policy, which can leave funds frozen for up to 180 days with no appeal process. Stripe’s geographical limitations mean creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan can't even sign up. Conversely, COREMERCH's infrastructure is built to serve regions overlooked by conventional platforms. By using cryptocurrency, creators can bypass national restrictions entirely, allowing them to sell stock photos and other digital products directly to consumers without fear of account suspensions or payment processing delays.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

While PayPal and Stripe may advertise their services as affordable, hidden fees can stack up quickly, especially for creators in restricted countries. PayPal's fees, combined with potential account freezes, create a volatile cost structure. COREMERCH offers an alternative with a transparent fee structure through NOWPayments, charging only a 0.5% fee per transaction and enabling fast, on-chain payment verification. This means creators can access their funds almost instantly while keeping transaction costs low, ensuring more of their earnings directly benefit them.
Say goodbye to account freezes and payment holds with COREMERCH.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Using platforms like PayPal or Stripe means you are at their mercy when it comes to the ownership of your data and products. They control the payment flow and can suspend accounts at will. With COREMERCH's sovereign stacks, you own everything after deployment. You are not just renting services; you are establishing a fully operational online store built on free and paid tools that automate payment processing and product delivery. This architecture ensures that your business operates independently, with full control over your assets.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you're facing restrictions from platforms like PayPal or Stripe, it's crucial to choose an architecture that empowers you. For those looking for a quick deployment, the Sovereign Starter Stack is ideal. If you're ready to scale and need more features, consider the Edge Commerce Stack. Regardless of your choice, COREMERCH's Complete Builder Kit provides all six blueprints and seven templates necessary to build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce stack seamlessly.

If Stripe isn't available in your country, you can still sell digital products using COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure. By leveraging alternatives like NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing, you can establish a fully operational online store without relying on restrictive platforms. This setup ensures you maintain control and ownership of your business.
